input.task: Write the investment thesis and recommendation from the two analysts' outputs.

Research Analyst.overview:
### Business Model
Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non‑Google businesses collectively as Other Bets [10‑K L222: "Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google."]

Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful guides every product and service we build, from Search to YouTube and Cloud [10‑K L228: "Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful"]
Research Analyst.market_positioning:
### Competitive Position
We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, from search engines to cloud providers and AI model developers [10‑K L326: "We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business"]

### Revenue Drivers
Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business, and we expect this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues [10‑K L900: "Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues."]

Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time [10‑K L902: "Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time."]

### Recent Growth
Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 13th consecutive quarter of double‑digit revenue growth [Release L14: "Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 13th consecutive quarter of double‑digit revenue growth."]
Research Analyst.future_developments:
### AI & Gemini Advances
Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet, showcases our leadership in generative and multimodal AI [10‑K L240: "Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet."]
All 15 of our half‑billion‑user products—including seven with two billion users—now leverage Gemini models, deepening AI integration across Search, YouTube and other services [10‑K L242: "today, all 15 of our half‑billion‑user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models."]

### Cloud Growth & Infrastructure
Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion, driven by enterprise AI infrastructure, AI solutions and strong TPU systems sales [Release L18: "Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion, led by strong growth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI infrastructure and enterprise AI solutions, as well as core GCP services. TPU systems sales were also a meaningful contributor to revenue growth."]

### Next‑Gen Model Frontiers
Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon are now leading at the frontier, with first‑party model APIs processing nearly 32 billion tokens per minute—more than four times the volume a year ago [Release L30: "Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon are now leading at the frontier. Overall, our first‑party model APIs are now processing nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, more than four times what we processed a year ago."]
Research Analyst.insight: Insight: Alphabet committed to major AI‑centric acquisitions this year, entering definitive agreements to acquire Wiz for $32.0 billion and Intersect for $4.8 billion, expanding its cloud security and data‑center capabilities [10‑K L1124: "We entered into definitive agreements to acquire Wiz, a leading cloud security platform, for $32.0 billion, subject to closing adjustments, in an all‑cash transaction"] and [10‑K L1126: "We entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Intersect, which provides data center and energy infrastructure solutions, for $4.8 billion in cash, plus the assumption of debt"]

input.expected_output: JSON with 'thesis', 'recommendation' (Buy, Hold or Sell), 'deciding_number' (its 'value' copied with its citation), 'strategic_recommendations' and 'insight' (one line starting 'Insight:').

output.thesis:
### Thesis
Alphabet continues to leverage its dominant AI and cloud platforms to drive robust top‑line growth and exceptional profitability. FY 2025 total revenue reached **$402.8 B**, up **15.09% YoY** ([XBRL GOOG us-gaap:Revenues 2025-12-31]), while Q3 2026 revenue surged **24.65% YoY** to **$127.6 B** ([Release L90: "Total revenues | $102,346 | $127,577"]).

Operating margin stands at **32.03%** ([ratio operating_margin: 129,039.0 / 402,836.0]), reflecting strong cost discipline and high‑margin cloud/AI services. Debt‑to‑equity is a modest **0.12x** ([ratio debt_to_equity: (46,547.0 + 1,996.0) / 415,265.0]), indicating a solid balance sheet. Free cash flow margin of **18.19%** ([ratio fcf_margin: (164,713.0 - 91,447.0) / 402,836.0]) underscores ample cash generation to fund strategic AI‑centric acquisitions (Wiz, Intersect) and reinvest in infrastructure.

The research narrative highlights continued AI model leadership (Gemini 3/4) and record‑breaking cloud growth (+103% YoY to **$30.7 B**), aligning with the financial results and supporting an optimistic outlook.

deciding_number.label: Operating margin
deciding_number.why: Operating margin of 32.03% (Financial Analyst) exceeds typical industry benchmarks, indicating high profitability that justifies a Buy recommendation.

output.strategic_recommendations:
### Strategic Recommendations
- **Accelerate AI integration**: Capitalize on Gemini 3/4 adoption across 15 flagship products to drive incremental ad and subscription revenue.
- **Leverage cloud momentum**: Continue investing in AI‑optimized infrastructure (TPU, GCP AI services) to sustain double‑digit cloud growth.
- **Execute AI‑centric acquisitions**: Close the Wiz and Intersect deals to broaden cloud security and data‑center capabilities, enhancing cross‑sell opportunities.
- **Maintain fiscal discipline**: Preserve low leverage (0.12x debt‑to‑equity) and strong free cash flow margins to fund R&D and shareholder returns.
- **Monitor competitive landscape**: Track rivals’ AI and cloud advances (Microsoft, Amazon, Meta) to ensure Alphabet retains its technology edge.
